outcome: Project-selection refusal tests compare the intended directory and preserve exact relative selector bytes without assuming Windows short and long path spellings are equal.
acceptance: Required project gates and independent Codex/Claude review pass on the corrected input
every_word_refuses_missing_cwd_project_without_search_or_store_creation passes with Windows short-path cwd spelling while retaining typed refusal, no ancestor search and no store creation assertions

completion.summary: Fixed Windows short/long cwd alias assumptions while preserving typed refusal, no ancestor search/store creation, exact hostile selector bytes and terminal safety. Actual 8.3 baseline reproduced both failures; corrected run passed 7 tests. Nine gates, paired review and independent acceptance passed all 3 unchanged criteria.
